---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary
A short, clear description of the feature or improvement you're proposing.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve, or what limitation are you running into? Explain the "why" before the "what" — this helps maintainers understand if this fits the project's direction.

## Proposed Solution
Describe what you'd like to see added or changed, in as much detail as you can. If you have an idea of how it could be implemented, include that too — but it's fine if you don't.

## Use Cases / Examples
Concrete examples of when and how this would be used. Real scenarios help far more than abstract descriptions.

## Alternatives Considered
Any other approaches you thought about, workarounds you're currently using, or how other projects/languages handle this — and why you think this proposal is better.

## Impact
Who does this help — all users, a specific group, maintainers, contributors? Is this a small addition or a larger design decision that needs discussion first?

## Additional Context
Anything else — links, references, sketches, or prior discussion that adds useful background.

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing Issues and Discussions and didn't find this already proposed
- [ ] For larger changes, I've considered starting a Discussion first before opening this
